title: 第4章  凝聚天灵根，楚枫屠狗！
content_zh:
赵有容猝不及防，下意识地惊呼出声。
她浑身一僵，像是被惊雷劈中，大脑瞬间一片空白。
“唔——”
一只罗袜从赵有容莹白的足尖滑落，坠入池水之中，清水泛起涟漪。
楚枫顺势将赵有容抵在池边，一股纯元能量涌入他体内。
炼天图微微震动了一下，而后开始鲸吞那股力量，而后尽数化为他体内的灵力。
与此同时，他的修为开始节节攀升，筑基四重、筑基五重、筑基六重……
他只是不忍心赵有容从此沦为废人，所以想要借此机会助其重聚灵根。
绝不是见色起意！
一个时辰后。
她美眸蒙上一层厚厚的水雾，大脑一片空白。
就在此时，楚枫凑到了她的耳旁。
“我夺了你的纯元，还你一道灵根。”
“什么？”
赵有容明显一怔，美眸瞬间睁大。
下一刻，她还没来得及反应，便觉得一股暖流从唇间涌入，径直涌向她的丹田。
赵有容下意识地挺起柳腰，身体弓起一个优美的弧度。
丹田处传来一阵胀痛，竟然重新凝聚出了灵根。
就在此时，窗外突然响起一声震彻天地的凤鸣！
金色的霞光骤然从云层中冲破，将整个青山城照得如同白昼。

天空之上，无数灵气汇聚，化作一只翼展百丈的火凤，盘旋在楚家上空。
“这是有天灵根降世！”
“哪家的福气这么好，竟然出了个天灵根的奇才。”
“看火凤盘旋的方向是赵家，赵家怕是要再次崛起了。”
青山城瞬间沸腾了，众人仰头望着天空中的火凤，皆是一脸震惊之色。
赵有容浑身骤然绷紧，娇躯不断颤动，让她难以置信的是自己体内的灵根竟然真的重聚了。
重聚灵根之后，修为也恢复到了炼气九重。
“我……我竟然有灵根了！”
楚枫缓缓吐出一口气，不愧是红鸾劫体。
那股纯元之力被他彻底吸收，修为突破到了筑基九重。
“只可惜这里的药材有限，只能帮你重聚天灵根。”
灵根分为黄、玄、地、天、圣，若是有足够好的药材，他甚至可以让赵有容涅槃进阶为圣灵根。
赵有容重新审视眼前的男人，她发现对方好像变得和印象中的楚枫不一样了。
“我听说只有涅槃丹才能帮我重聚灵根，你是怎么做到的？”
楚枫点了点头，淡然道。
“我刚刚炼制的就是涅槃丹。”
赵有容浑身一颤，涅槃丹可是八品丹药啊！
就算是云天宫都找不到一个八品丹师帮她炼制涅槃丹，不然也不会将她逐出宗门了。
楚枫竟然是八品炼药师！
她的呼吸越发急促，而后直接扑进了楚枫的怀里。

如果不是楚枫，她可能一辈子都要被囚禁在灵池之中。
楚枫现在只是筑基八重，依旧不是赵泰的对手，她必须尽快帮助楚枫突破到金丹境。
“别说话，吻我……”
半个时辰后，灵池暖阁内水汽氤氲。
赵有容倚着冰凉的池壁，湿漉漉的墨发黏在肩头，晶莹的水珠顺着锁骨缓缓滑落。
起初她是抱着献祭自己的心思想要做楚枫的炉鼎，助楚枫修行。
万万没想到，不仅没被榨干修为，反而一举突破到了筑基境。
她抬眼望向灵池中央的楚枫，水光潋滟的眸子里满是羞赧。
“你还没突破到金丹境，我还可以……”
此刻的她，宛若被狂风骤雨摧残过的牡丹，浑身覆着细碎的水珠。
眉眼间带着一丝不自知的媚态，眼角泛着水光，愈发惹人怜惜。
楚枫见状，心中微动，食指轻轻抵在她唇边。
“别逞强，我已经突破到筑基九重了，你只管好好休息。”
说罢，他开始运转炼天图。
灵池中的灵气仿佛受到牵引，化作莹白气流源源不断涌入他体内，周身气息愈发浑厚。
一个时辰转瞬即逝。
当灵池灵气渐趋稀薄时，一道璀璨金光骤然从天而降，笼罩住楚枫周身！
金光耀眼夺目，驱散了所有白雾，海量天地之力顺着金光涌入他体内，气息骤然暴涨，突破筑基九重桎梏，踏入筑基至极境！
青山城众人齐刷刷抬头望向光柱升起的方向，皆是一脸震惊之色。
“这是突破到至极境的异象！”

“已经有两道光柱亮起了，难不成赵家出了两个至极境强者？”
“我可是听说，楚家那个废婿楚枫好像恢复了修为，将赵家杀了个天翻地覆，连赵家嫡子赵德柱都被他宰了！”
“楚枫当年为了赵雪莲，连至尊骨都挖了，这赵家也是报应啊。”
“他就算恢复了修为，也绝不可能是赵泰的对手，若是赵泰回来……”
就在这时，远处传来一阵急促的马蹄声，尘土飞扬，隐约能看到一队人马朝着赵家方向疾驰而去。
为首的那道身影气势凛然，正是赵家主赵泰！
“快看，赵泰回来了！”
楚枫睁眼时，眸中金光一闪而逝。
他手掌一翻，掌心多了一枚令牌。
赵德柱并没有说谎，这确实是万兽宗的《御兽灵诀》，而且是赵德柱从万兽宗盗取的至宝。
前世他获得炼天图拥有了足够的实力，想要寻赵家复仇，却发现赵家已经被万兽宗给灭了。
就是因为赵德柱盗取《御兽灵诀》的事情败露，所以赵家才被万兽宗灭门。
“现在最重要的就是提升实力，此功法与我有缘，合该我修炼。”
楚枫运转炼天图，手中令牌震动，一道道流光涌入他的额头。
他的脑海之中多了一道记忆，那是《御兽灵诀》的修炼之法。
传闻，万兽宗已经近万年无人能参悟出这令牌之中的《御兽灵诀》。
但炼天图可以炼化功法，无需参悟修炼，直接功法灌顶。
所以，这旁人无法参悟的功法，对于他来说却像是吃饭喝水一样简单。
此时暖阁门被轻轻推开，赵有容走了进来。
她换上一袭紫色长裙，束带勒出纤细腰肢，裙摆下的双腿修长笔直，每一步都带着摇曳风情。

经过方才的滋养，她肌肤愈发白皙细腻，多了几分成熟韵味。
楚枫从池中走出，水珠顺着胸膛滑落。
“我已经突破到筑基至极境了。”
“我……我来帮你。”
赵有容深吸一口气，鼓起勇气上前，手中攥着一方锦帕，声音带着不易察觉的颤抖。
她走到楚枫面前时，脸颊红得快要滴血，不敢抬头看他，只能低着头从肩头开始擦拭。
擦净身子后，赵有容拿起长袍为楚枫披上。
楚枫微微侧身配合，鼻尖萦绕着她发间的清香，心中一片柔软。
“好了。”
赵有容后退一步，看着穿戴整齐的楚枫，声音轻柔。
“筑基至极境，距离金丹境只剩一步之遥了。”
楚枫点头刚要说话，却见赵有容神色骤然凝重，咬着唇像是下定了决心。
沉默片刻后，她抬头看向他，眼神带着愧疚。
“有件事我一直想告诉你，你父母的死，或许另有隐情。”
“你知道什么？”
楚枫神色瞬间变冷，周身温度骤降。
父母的死，是他心中最深的痛，也是他重生的执念。
赵有容看着他骤然冰冷的神色，心中一紧，却还是硬着头皮说道。
“天泉雪莲送来灵池的前几天，我在暖阁里，半夜听到外面有人说话。
其中一个是赵泰的声音，另一个很陌生，他们在商议……在你父母去荒古禁地的路上动手劫杀。

那时候我被玄铁锁链拴着，根本出不去，也没法提醒楚叔叔……”
话音刚落，楚枫周身爆发出恐怖怒火。
前世他因为挖出了至尊骨，导致灵根受损，无法修行。
赵泰前来告诉他父亲，荒古禁地有修复灵根的仙药，还绘制了路线图。
父母为了他，不顾危险毅然前往，最终葬身禁地。
原来这一切都是赵泰设下的毒计！
他父母根本不是死在荒古禁地，而是死在了赵泰的手中。
楚枫拳头攥紧，眼神中是滔天杀意，那股狠戾让赵有容都忍不住浑身一颤。
“赵泰！我定要将你碎尸万段！”
门外被钉仙杵拴在地上的赵雪莲，将两人的对话听得一清二楚。
此刻听到真相被揭开，赵雪莲下意识缩了缩脖子，眼神躲闪着不敢看向暖阁方向。
这件事她也知情，谁让那两个老东西挡了她的路。
她死死咬着嘴唇，不敢发出一丝声响，只能在心中疯狂祈祷父亲快点回来救她。
就在此时，楚枫豁然转头看向了门外的方向。
他的神识已经可以笼罩整个赵家，赵泰回来了！
楚枫走出暖阁，牵着锁链，一脚抵在了赵雪莲的屁股上。
“走！”
赵雪莲浑身一震，很快便意识到了楚枫想要干嘛。
她豁然转头，厉声道。
“你竟然想要让我爬出去？”

楚枫抬脚狠狠踩在她的脚腕上，肆意碾动。
“给老子爬！”
赵雪莲疼的蜷缩在地上，浑身都在颤抖。
“我爬，我爬！”
就这样，楚枫牵着赵雪莲走出了别院。
见状，赵有容有些急切地问道。
“你要去哪？”
楚枫牵着赵雪莲冷声道。
“我去屠狗。”
content_en:
Zhao Yourong was caught off guard and subconsciously exclaimed.
Her whole body froze, as if she had been struck by thunder, and her mind went blank for a moment.
"Uh-"
A pair of socks slipped from Zhao Yourong's white toes and fell into the pool water, causing ripples in the clear water.
Chu Feng took advantage of the situation and pushed Zhao Yourong against the edge of the pool, and a stream of pure energy poured into his body.
The Heaven Refining Diagram shook slightly, and then began to swallow up the power, and then turned it all into the spiritual power in his body.
At the same time, his cultivation level began to rise steadily, reaching the fourth level of foundation building, the fifth level of foundation building, the sixth level of foundation building...
He just couldn't bear that Zhao Yourong would become a useless person from now on, so he wanted to take this opportunity to help him regain his spiritual roots.
It’s definitely not out of lust!
An hour later.
Her beautiful eyes were covered with a thick layer of mist, and her mind went blank.
At this moment, Chu Feng came close to her ear.
"I took away your pure essence and gave you back a spiritual root."
"What?"
Zhao Yourong was obviously startled, and his beautiful eyes widened instantly.
The next moment, before she had time to react, she felt a warm current pouring in from her lips and going straight to her Dantian.
Zhao Yourong subconsciously straightened up his waist and arched his body in a graceful arc.
There was a burst of swelling pain in the Dantian, and the spiritual roots were re-condensed.
At this moment, a phoenix cry suddenly sounded outside the window that shook the world!
The golden glow suddenly broke through the clouds, illuminating the entire Qingshan City like daylight.
In the sky, countless spiritual energies gathered together and turned into a fire phoenix with a wingspan of a hundred feet, hovering over the Chu family.
"This is the arrival of heavenly spiritual roots into the world!"
"Which family is so lucky to have a genius with Tianling roots?"
"Look at the fire phoenix circling in the direction of the Zhao family. The Zhao family is afraid that it will rise again."
Qingshan City boiled instantly, and everyone looked up at the fire phoenix in the sky with shocked expressions on their faces.
Zhao Yourong's whole body suddenly tensed up, and her delicate body continued to tremble. To her disbelief, the spiritual roots in her body had actually reunited.
After reuniting his spiritual roots, his cultivation level returned to the ninth level of Qi Refining.
"I...I actually have spiritual roots!"
Chu Feng slowly exhaled, it was indeed Hong Luan Jie Body.
That pure energy was completely absorbed by him, and his cultivation level broke through to the ninth level of foundation building.
"It's a pity that the medicinal materials here are limited. I can only help you reunite your Tianlinggen."
Spiritual roots are divided into Huang, Xuan, Earth, Heaven, and Saint. If there are enough good medicinal materials, he can even advance Zhao Yourong to Nirvana and become the Holy Spirit Root.
Zhao Yourong re-examined the man in front of her, and she found that he seemed to be different from the Chu Feng in her impression.
"I heard that only the Nirvana Pill can help me reunite my spiritual roots. How did you do it?"
Chu Feng nodded and said calmly.
"What I just refined is the Nirvana Pill."
Zhao Yourong trembled all over, Nirvana Pill was an eighth-grade pill!
Even Yuntian Palace couldn't find an eighth-grade alchemist to help her refine the Nirvana Pill, otherwise she wouldn't have been expelled from the sect.
Chu Feng turned out to be an eighth-grade alchemist!
Her breathing became more rapid, and then she threw herself into Chu Feng's arms.
If it weren't for Chu Feng, she might have been imprisoned in the spirit pool for the rest of her life.
Chu Feng is only at the eighth level of Foundation Establishment now and is still no match for Zhao Tai. She must help Chu Feng break through to the Golden Core Realm as soon as possible.
"Stop talking, kiss me..."
Half an hour later, the Lingchi Nuan Pavilion was filled with water vapor.
Zhao Yourong leaned against the cold pool wall, his wet black hair stuck to his shoulders, and crystal water drops slowly slid down his collarbone.
At first, she had the intention of sacrificing herself and wanted to be Chu Feng's cauldron to help Chu Feng in his cultivation.
Unexpectedly, not only was he not drained of his cultivation, but he broke through to the foundation building realm in one fell swoop.
She raised her eyes and looked at Chu Feng in the center of the spiritual pool, her watery eyes full of shame.
"You haven't broken through to the Golden Core Realm yet, I can still..."
At this moment, she looked like a peony that had been damaged by the violent wind and rain, covered with tiny drops of water.
There is a trace of unconsciousness between the eyebrows and eyesThe charming look, the corners of her eyes were shining, making her even more pitiful.
When Chu Feng saw this, his heart moved slightly, and his index finger gently touched her lips.
"Don't be brave, I have already broken through to the ninth level of foundation building, just take a good rest."
After that, he started to run the Heaven Refining Diagram.
The spiritual energy in the spiritual pool seemed to be drawn, turning into a stream of crystal white air and pouring into his body continuously, and the aura around him became thicker and thicker.
An hour flies by.
When the spiritual energy of the spirit pool gradually became thinner, a bright golden light suddenly fell from the sky and enveloped Chu Feng!
The golden light was dazzling, dispelling all the white mist, and a massive amount of power from heaven and earth poured into his body along with the golden light. His aura suddenly surged, breaking through the nine shackles of foundation building, and stepping into the ultimate realm of foundation building!
Everyone in Qingshan City raised their heads and looked in the direction where the light pillar was rising, with shocked expressions on their faces.
"This is a vision that reaches the ultimate level!"
"Two beams of light have already lit up. Is it possible that the Zhao family has two extremely powerful people?"
"I heard that Chu Feng, the abandoned son-in-law of the Chu family, seemed to have recovered his cultivation and turned the Zhao family upside down. Even Zhao Dezhu, the direct son of the Zhao family, was killed by him!"
"Chu Feng even dug up the bones of the Supreme Being for Zhao Xuelian back then. This is also retribution for the Zhao family."
"Even if he recovers his cultivation, he will never be Zhao Tai's opponent. If Zhao Tai comes back..."
At this moment, there was a rapid sound of horse hooves in the distance, dust was flying, and a group of people could be vaguely seen galloping towards the Zhao family.
The imposing figure at the head is none other than Zhao Tai, the head of the Zhao family!
"Look, Zhao Tai is back!"
When Chu Feng opened his eyes, the golden light flashed in his eyes.
He turned his palm over, and there was an extra token in his palm.
Zhao Dezhu did not lie. This was indeed the "Spiritual Art of Controlling Beasts" of the Ten Thousand Beast Sect, and it was a treasure that Zhao Dezhu had stolen from the Ten Thousand Beast Sect.
In his previous life, he obtained the Heaven Refining Map and gained enough strength. He wanted to seek revenge from the Zhao family, but found that the Zhao family had been destroyed by the Ten Thousand Beasts Sect.
It was because Zhao Dezhu's theft of the "Spiritual Secrets of Controlling Beasts" was exposed that the Zhao family was exterminated by the Ten Thousand Beast Sect.
"The most important thing now is to improve my strength. This technique is destined for me and should be practiced by me."
Chu Feng rotated the Heaven Refining Diagram, the token in his hand vibrated, and streams of light poured into his forehead.
There was an additional memory in his mind, which was the training method of "Spiritual Art of Controlling Beasts".
Rumor has it that no one in the Ten Thousand Beast Sect has been able to comprehend the "Spiritual Secret of Beast Control" contained in this token for nearly ten thousand years.
However, the Heaven Alchemy Map can refine the skills without any need to comprehend and practice, and the skills can be directly initiated.
Therefore, this technique that others cannot understand is as simple as eating and drinking to him.
At this time, the Nuange door was gently pushed open, and Zhao Yourong walked in.
She put on a purple dress, with a belt that stretched out her slender waist. Her legs under the skirt were long and straight, with a swaying charm in every step.
After being nourished just now, her skin became fairer and more delicate, with a more mature charm.
Chu Feng walked out of the pool, water drops sliding down his chest.
"I have broken through to the ultimate level of foundation building."
"I...I'm here to help you."
Zhao Yourong took a deep breath and plucked up the courage to step forward, holding a brocade handkerchief in his hand with an imperceptible tremor in his voice.
When she walked in front of Chu Feng, her cheeks were so red that they were almost bleeding. She didn't dare to raise her head to look at him, so she could only lower her head and wipe it from her shoulders.
After wiping himself clean, Zhao Yourong picked up the robe and put it on Chu Feng.
Chu Feng turned slightly to cooperate, the fragrance of her hair lingering on the tip of his nose, and his heart felt soft.
"Okay."
Zhao Yourong took a step back, looked at Chu Feng who was neatly dressed, and spoke softly.
"Building the foundation to the extreme realm is only one step away from the Golden Core realm."
Chu Feng nodded and was about to speak when he saw Zhao Yourong's expression suddenly serious and he bit his lip as if he had made up his mind.
After a moment of silence, she looked up at him with guilt in her eyes.
"There is something I have always wanted to tell you. There may be another hidden reason behind your parents' death."
"You knowWhat do you mean? "
Chu Feng's expression turned cold instantly, and his body temperature dropped sharply.
The death of his parents was the deepest pain in his heart, and it was also his obsession with rebirth.
Zhao Yourong's heart tightened when she saw his suddenly cold expression, but she still spoke bravely.
"A few days before Tianquan Snow Lotus was delivered to the Lingchi, I was in the Nuan Pavilion and heard someone talking outside in the middle of the night.
One of them is Zhao Tai's voice, and the other is very strange. They are discussing... to rob and kill your parents on their way to the ancient forbidden land.
At that time, I was tied by black iron chains and couldn't get out at all, and I couldn't remind Uncle Chu..."
As soon as he finished speaking, Chu Feng's whole body erupted with terrifying anger.
In his previous life, he dug out the Supreme Bone, which damaged his spiritual roots and made him unable to practice.
Zhao Tai came to tell his father that there was an elixir to repair spiritual roots in the ancient forbidden land, and he also drew a road map.
For his sake, his parents resolutely went there regardless of the danger, and were eventually buried in a forbidden place.
It turns out that all this is a poisonous plan set by Zhao Tai!
His parents did not die in the ancient forbidden land at all, but in the hands of Zhao Tai.
Chu Feng clenched his fists tightly, and his eyes were full of murderous intent. Such ferocity made Zhao Yourong couldn't help but tremble all over.
“Zhao Tai! I will definitely cut you into pieces! "
Zhao Xuelian, who was tied to the ground with a nailed fairy pestle outside the door, heard the conversation between the two clearly.
Hearing that the truth was revealed at this moment, Zhao Xuelian subconsciously shrank her neck and avoided looking in the direction of Nuan Pavilion.
She also knew about this matter, who let those two old guys block her way.
She bit her lip tightly, not daring to make a sound. She could only pray wildly in her heart that her father would come back to save her soon.
At this moment, Chu Feng suddenly turned his head and looked in the direction outside the door.
His consciousness can already cover the entire Zhao family, Zhao Tai is back!
Chu Feng walked out of Nuan Pavilion, held the chain, and put his foot on Zhao Xuelian's butt.
"Go! "
Zhao Xuelian was shocked and soon realized what Chu Feng wanted to do.
She suddenly turned her head and said sternly.
"You actually want me to crawl out? "
Chu Feng raised his foot and stepped hard on her ankle, crushing it wantonly.
"Climb for me! "
Zhao Xuelian curled up on the ground in pain, her whole body trembling.
"I crawl, I crawl! "
Just like that, Chu Feng led Zhao Xuelian out of the other courtyard.
Seeing this, Zhao Yourong asked eagerly.
"Where are you going? "
Chu Feng held Zhao Xuelian's hand and said coldly.
"I'm going to kill the dog. "
